text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated — miniwave (5%) to prod-us-west-2. Release tag: v3.14.0-canary, commit: 9abf3cd. Initiated by @carla. RolloutID: rlt-20260320-42. Cerberus checks enabled. :rocket:
carla: starting smoke checks now, I'll watch latency, p95 and error rate. ping me if anything > thresholds. :eyes:
mike_sre: watching infra. set alert knobs: p50 > 120ms OR 5xx > 0.5% -> page oncall.
deploy-bot: [health-snapshot] p50=85ms p95=210ms error_rate=0.2% cpu=48% gpu_mem=71% (canary nodes). snapshot_ts=2026-03-20T15:01:40Z
anya: small uptick in GPU mem on canary nodes, +8% vs baseline. not huge but noticed.
jun: checked logs -> brief OOM spike from model-worker-5 at 2026-03-20T15:02:05Z, stack shows quantized-kernel path. filing log snippet:```
2026-03-20T15:02:05Z model-worker-5 OOM alloc 1.2G
stack: quant_ops::fused_attn -> kv_cache
```
carla: placing manual hold at 5% while we triage OOMs. do not promote until we confirm. :hand:
mike_sre: agree with hold. set rollback threshold to 1% errors over 10m window. can we drain cohort and re-run smoke if needed?
deploy-bot: Action taken: Rollout paused by carla. Traffic remains at 5%. To drain cohort run `/deploy drain rlt-20260320-42 --cohort=canary` or to promote `/deploy promote rlt-20260320-42 50%`.
anya: quick patch ready to avoid fused kernel path (skips fused kernel on quantized models). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/1234. will push patch to canary on approval.
release-manager: decision: hold. require patch + 15m stable before any promotion. tagging incident note in release board. :memo:
--- 20 minutes later ---
deploy-bot: Patch deployed to canary cohort (tag: v3.14.0-canary-patch1), commit: b7c22aa. Replaced canary nodes and restarted canary workers. Cerberus: quick pass.
mike_sre: metrics trending better after patch. p95 -> 150ms, error_rate -> 0.05% over last 12m. no new OOMs on worker-5. :thumbsup:
carla: good. promoting to 50% now. runbook: watch p95 and 5xx for 20m.
deploy-bot: Promotion started: 5% -> 50% for rlt-20260320-42. Estimated duration: 8m. new rollout sub-id: rlt-20260320-42-1. target tag: v3.14.0-canary-patch1 (commit b7c22aa).
observability-bot: alert cleared: spike-model-worker-ooms (no active signals).
jun: runbook checks green, health probes returning 200 for sample traffic.
--- 10 minutes later ---
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Now serving 100% in prod-us-west-2. Final tag: v3.14.0. Release notes: https://go/release-notes/v3.14.0. If regressions appear, rollback with `/deploy rollback rlt-20260320-42 --to-tag=v3.13.9`
carla: nice work everyone. filing short postmortem on OOM trigger and follow-up to add extra mem headroom in quant path. :white_check_mark:
mike_sre: I'll update runbook with new rollback thresholds and a quick remediation play for quant-kernel OOMs.
deploy-bot: Rollout closed. Duration: 28m. Logs archived to s3://redwood-deploy-logs/rlt-20260320-42.zip. :package:
